headline: UK announces new funding for zero-emission vehicle technology
summary: Nearly £130 million is set to support zero-emission vehicle technology as Britain pushes cleaner transport.
script: Britain is putting nearly one hundred and thirty million pounds into zero-emission vehicle technology. The funding is aimed at cleaner transport, from electric powertrains to charging systems, as the UK tries to cut road emissions.
